put.summary: Replace ONE WEEK's project split on a request line, in one transaction
put.description: WHOLE-SET REPLACE scoped to a single week: delete-then-insert inside one transaction. Body: { weekStartDate, splits: [ { projectRefId, projectNumber, projectName, taskId, taskNumber, taskName, splitPct } ] }. weekStartDate is REQUIRED - without it the replace would wipe every week's split on the line. The client never reconciles slice ids and percentages-sum-to-100 stays a single transactional invariant. Idempotent, so a double-click cannot double-author. Rejects a total other than 100 (compared in basis points, never floating-point equality - of the 49,985,001 three-slice combinations summing to exactly 100.00, 8.55% do not compare equal to 100 as floats), a single slice, and a duplicate (projectRefId, taskId) within the week.

projectNumber.description: The project this row actually posted to. NULL = header project.

taskNumber.description: The task this row actually posted to. NULL = header task.

post.summary: Create a posted-week ledger row (forward post)
post.description: Writes a POSTED ORIGINAL row (or any ledger row) into EQR_POSTED_WEEK. Amounts are copied from the engine/view (anti-V190).

post.summary: Post ONE week as N ledger rows, one per project slice, in a single transaction
post.description: Same body as createPostedWeek plus splits: [ { projectRefId, projectNumber, taskId, taskNumber, splitPct } ]. Deliberately ONE call per week and not N calls: the frontend accounting is per week and has no way to express or clean up a half-posted week, and there is no pre-Fusion reversal path to undo one with. THE CLIENT SENDS NO PER-SLICE DOLLAR FIGURES - it sends the single view-sourced postedCostAmount plus the percentages, and the server apportions by largest remainder (residual cent to the largest slice, ties by lowest projectRefId) so SUM(POSTED_COST_AMOUNT) equals the week amount exactly, guaranteed by the same transaction that inserts the rows. That keeps the anti-V190 rule intact: the client never does cost math. All N rows share one SPLIT_GROUP_ID, keep the SAME rowKey (the detail view ledger guard is an EXISTS test on ROW_KEY, so N rows sharing it still retire the row), and get a server-derived REVERSAL_REF of EQR-<lineId>-<weekYYYYMMDD>-P<projectRefId>-T<taskId> - deterministic, so a re-post regenerates identical refs and stays a benign no-op.

get.summary: Resolve page-access levels for the caller's Fusion job role(s)
get.description: Page-level RBAC resolve. Returns a flat map of PAGE_CODE -> ACCESS_LEVEL ('FULL' | 'READ_ONLY' | 'HIDDEN') for APPLICATION_CODE='EQUIP_RITE', for the supplied Fusion/IDCS job role(s). Backed by COMMONRITE RBAC_ROLE_MAP -> RBAC_APP_ROLES -> RBAC_ROLE_PAGE_ACCESS. When more than one role is supplied the MOST PERMISSIVE level wins (FULL > READ_ONLY > HIDDEN). A page with no row for the role is OMITTED from the map; the client treats absent as HIDDEN (fail-closed). An unknown/unmapped role returns an empty map, not an error.

put.summary: Batch-save page access levels for ONE role
put.description: Upserts RBAC_ROLE_PAGE_ACCESS rows for the supplied appRoleId. One call per Save of the Admin grid, carrying only the dirty rows. MUST be scoped to the single appRoleId in the payload and must never write other roles' rows. Upsert on the natural key (APPLICATION_CODE, APP_ROLE_ID, PAGE_CODE) - RBAC_PAGE_ACC_UK - so re-saving an unchanged page is idempotent. MODIFIED_BY is NOT NULL with no default: set it from the authenticated caller. Rows with IS_LOCKED='Y' must be rejected, not silently skipped.

200.description: Saved; returns the rows as persisted

400.description: Unknown pageCode / invalid accessLevel / locked row

Distinct from /rbac/page-access, which resolves ONE role and OMITS non-granted pages - that shape cannot drive an editing grid. A page with no row for a role must be returned with accessLevel 'HIDDEN' so the grid shows a real value rather than a blank.

get.summary: Session roles for the caller's Fusion job roles

One row per SESSION_ROLE at its lowest PRIORITY, ordered by priority then sessionRole. Matches ORACLE_ROLE_NAME case-insensitively. Returns the WHOLE ordered list, not one winner, because generic ORA_* job roles map to legacy session roles (ADMIN 10, EQUIP_MANAGER 20) that outrank every RT_EQP_* role but have no dashboard; the client takes the first role it has a layout for. post.summary: Persist the confirm. One call per bucket.
post.description: Call once per bucket after a 202 from OIC. Stamps the yard pair onto allocations and the line, promotes lineStatus to SCHEDULED_FOR_PICKING, and marks the reservation CONSUMED. Omit source/dest org fields for the F&M variant.

post.summary: Free reservations when the OIC call fails.

post.summary: Resolve the inbound routes a return WOULD send. Read-only.
post.description: Calls get_return_routes + get_return_blocks. bucketKey is 'source|dest' (e.g. '005|001'), NOT a bare yard code: the return fans out by DESTINATION because the source is usually the single virtual org, and keying on source alone would collapse every line into one Transfer Order. CRITICAL - blocks are NOT block-all on the return leg. Unlike the outbound /plan, a blocked line here must NOT stop the resolvable ones: refusing the whole return would strand real equipment on site because one line lost its yard stamp. Send the routes, surface the blocks. fAndMLineIds is always [] on returns - record_return promotes both classes identically.

post.summary: Reserve lines before the inbound OIC call.
post.description: MUST send leg='INBOUND'. The endpoint validates but deliberately does NOT rewrite it, so a wrong value surfaces as a bug rather than being hidden behind a reservation recorded against the wrong leg. The unique index is on (request_line_id, leg) while PENDING, so an outbound and a return over the same line coexist. replayed=true means this exact intent was already recorded - treat as SUCCESS, create nothing.

NO yard stamp - the return reverses a movement already recorded on the line, and writing one would fabricate a second leg. batchNumber is OPTIONAL here (unlike the outbound /record): record_return neither consumes nor settles a batch. Re-recording an already-returned line yields linesPromoted 0 - skipped, never reversed.

post.summary: Free inbound reservations when the OIC call fails.
post.description: Marks the batch's reservations ABANDONED so the lines are immediately returnable again, rather than waiting out the 15-minute TTL.

post.summary: Lines whose Transfer Order failed or stalled in Fusion.
post.description: Read-only sweep. reasonCode TO_FAILED = every TO for that line+leg failed, retryable once the cause is fixed. TO_STALLED = a TO is still in SR_CREATED, which is the OIC poller's work queue - the poller re-reads it every 2 minutes and still owns the row, so a retry would RACE it. Never offer retry on TO_STALLED.

parameters.name: X-User-Id

Returns 409 CONFLICT when any inbound TO for the line SUCCEEDED - the equipment is genuinely in transit and rolling back would assert it is still on site. The 409 body carries a readable sentence: surface it verbatim, it is a business outcome and not a server fault.

Calls EQR_ITEM_IMPORT_MERGE_PKG.resolve_and_promote. Applies EQR_CONF_CLASS_MAPPING to rows in EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_T, then upserts the MAPPED ones into EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER keyed on FUSION_INVENTORY_ITEM_ID. AMBIGUOUS / UNMAPPED / NO_UNIT_PATHWAY rows are held in staging for a person to resolve and are never auto-promoted.

Idempotent and re-runnable: it will not overwrite a RESOLVED_CLASS_ID a person has already set, so it is safe to call again after someone resolves an ambiguous row.

Called by the Import chain after the OIC batch loop finishes. See docs/ITEM_IMPORT_BACKEND_ASKS.md.

delete.description:
Clears staging rows nobody has acted on, so a bad or over-broad import can be discarded without losing work.

DELETES ONLY WHERE RESOLVED_CLASS_ID IS NULL. Two populations are protected:
 - MAPPED rows carry a class a HUMAN chose. Fusion can re-send the item; it cannot re-send the decision.
 - MERGED rows are the audit trail linking a staged row to its master row, and they drive the ALREADY_MERGED rejection on the assignments PATCH.

Not needed before re-importing: a FULL sync already clears staging on batch 1. This exists for 'the last import brought in junk, let me start over'.

patch.summary: Bulk-assign class/subclass to staged Fusion items
patch.description:
Writes RESOLVED_CLASS_ID / RESOLVED_SUBCLASS_ID on EQR_EQUIPMENT_MASTER_T and sets IMPORT_STATUS='MAPPED'.

The status write is LOAD-BEARING: resolve_and_promote selects WHERE IMPORT_STATUS='MAPPED' AND RESOLVED_CLASS_ID IS NOT NULL, so a class written without the status leaves the row unpromotable and the user's work silently does nothing. Here MAPPED means 'a human decided', not 'a rule fired'.

MAPPED also overrides NO_UNIT_PATHWAY -- those items have a valid definition and may be promoted; they simply have no units yet.

Bulk by design. One call per row costs ~15s of spinner at 100 rows and yields a failure list nobody can act on; per-row granularity comes back via failed[].

post.summary: Create / link equipment classes and subclasses from Fusion class-subclass pairs (dryRun previews without writing)

ExpTypeMapDto.description: One authored link between a scope (equipment master / subclass / class) and a Fusion expenditure type. NOT project-scoped, deliberately: expenditure types are shared across rate schedules, so one mapping is correct in every country.

scopeId.description: Id of the row at that scope. Polymorphic - there is no FK; the service validates it.

expenditureType.description: Fusion ExpenditureTypeName. VARCHAR2(80), the same width as EQR_REQUEST_LINE.EXPENDITURE_TYPE, so a mapped value always fits the column it gets written into.

expenditureTypeId.description: Fusion id when known. Usually null - the LOV path returns names without ids. The NAME is the key.

isDefault.description: Y | N. At most one Y per scope, enforced in the service.

mapSource.description: MANUAL | SEED | LEARNED. LEARNED is reserved for the not-yet-built learn-from-first-pick path and is rejected on create.

objectVersionNumber.description: Hibernate @Version seeds this at 0 on a fresh row, overriding the column's DEFAULT 1. Do NOT build UI logic on 'starts at 1'.

mapSource.description: MANUAL (default) or SEED. LEARNED is rejected.

ExpTypeMapPatchRequest.description: Every field optional; omitted means leave unchanged. scopeType/scopeId are not patchable.

expenditureTypeId.description: A bare null means LEAVE UNCHANGED, not 'clear'. Use clearExpenditureTypeId to null it.

VEquipmentBundleDto.description: One suggestion, from the point of view of the item being viewed (the ANCHOR). A reciprocal link yields a FORWARD row on the primary item and a REVERSE row on the associated item.

relationLabel.description: Accessory / Works with, Consumable / Used with, Safety gear / Used with, Pairs with

suggestedQuantity.description: DEFAULT_QUANTITY on FORWARD rows, always 1 on REVERSE rows.

EquipmentBundleLinkDto.description: One authored pair in EQR_EQUIPMENT_BUNDLE_LINK. The pair is unique in either direction.

isReciprocal.description: Y | N. N hides the REVERSE suggestion.

objectVersionNumber.description: API-created rows start at 0 (Hibernate), seeded rows at 1 (DB default). Do NOT build UI logic on either.

EquipmentBundleLinkPatchRequest.description: Every field optional; omitted/null means leave unchanged. The equipment ids are not patchable.

scopeName.description: Equipment master name / subclass name / class name. The primary identifier in the grid.

scopeCode.description: EQUIPMENT_NUMBER for MASTER, subclass/class code otherwise. DISPLAY ONLY - EQUIPMENT_NUMBER is not unique (212 distinct across 306 masters), so never key or dedupe on it.

resolvedLevel.description: MASTER | SUBCLASS | CLASS | NONE. NONE is a success, and means 'no mapping authored' - show the full project list.

ExpTypeResolveResponse.description: Envelope is { data } only - no recordCount/page/pageSize, unlike every other list here.

fusionSourceType.description: Which Fusion classification the class was mapped from. NULL for hand-typed classes.

fusionClassType.description: Which Fusion category type fusionClassRef is (EQP_CATEGORY_LOV_RP P_CATEGORY_TYPE). Universal list per source (CATEGORY_TYPES in configurations-page.js): INVENTORY = CATEGORY, CAT_SEGMENTn, CAT_* and ITEM_* DFF columns, DFF_ATTRIBUTEn (item ATTRIBUTEn); FIXED_ASSET = MAJOR, MINOR, FA_SEGMENTn, FA_* category and asset columns; MAINTENANCE = ITEM, WO_TYPE, WO_SUB_TYPE, MNT_* columns. For any non-id type the ref is the column value, CATALOG retired; FIXED_ASSET: MAJOR|MINOR, MAINTENANCE: ITEM|WO_TYPE|WO_SUB_TYPE. NULL on rows mapped before it existed = the source's old fixed type (CATALOG / MAJOR / ITEM).

fusionClassTypeName.description: Display name of fusionClassType at mapping time, e.g. 'Category (Inv_Items)' or the DFF segment prompt behind DFF_ATTRIBUTEn. Kept because the segment behind a DFF column can change in Fusion.

fusionClassRef.description: LOV_ID from EQP_CLASS_LOV_RP: CATEGORY_SET_ID (INVENTORY), FA major category SEGMENT1 (FIXED_ASSET), INVENTORY_ITEM_ID (MAINTENANCE).

fusionClassCode.description: LOV_CODE from EQP_CLASS_LOV_RP at mapping time.

fusionClassName.description: LOV_NAME from EQP_CLASS_LOV_RP at mapping time; compare with Fusion to detect renames.

fusionSubclassType.description: Which Fusion category type fusionSubclassRef is. INVENTORY: any type other than the class's; otherwise must nest under the class's fusionClassType. NULL on rows mapped before it existed = CATEGORY / MINOR / WO_TYPE.

fusionSubclassTypeName.description: Display name of fusionSubclassType at mapping time (see EquipmentClassDto.fusionClassTypeName).

fusionSubclassRef.description: SUBCLASS LOV_ID from EQP_CLASS_LOV_RP: CATEGORY_ID (INVENTORY), FA CATEGORY_ID (FINANCE), DFLT_WO_TYPE (MAINTENANCE). Values as FIXED_ASSET for the fixed-asset axis. Read with the parent class's fusionSourceType.

fusionSubclassCode.description: LOV_CODE from EQP_CLASS_LOV_RP at mapping time.

fusionSubclassName.description: LOV_NAME from EQP_CLASS_LOV_RP at mapping time; compare with Fusion to detect renames.

timesheetEntryEnabled.description: Y/N. Real column (V201); the service returns it and PATCH persists it -- confirmed by the backend 2026-09-24. It was absent from this spec, which is why a consumer could not read it back.

deliveryLocationType.description: PROJECT_SITE | DELIVERY_LOCATION | INV_ORG — which Delivery Location mode the requester used on create-request. Free text in the DB (no check constraint until the value set is agreed). MUST stay declared here: VB strips any request/response field the schema does not name, and this rides the POST body.

deliveryInvOrgId.description: Fusion inventory OrganizationId of the chosen internal delivery location. Set only when deliveryLocationType is INV_ORG. Sent to Fusion as OperatingOrganizationId when the maintenance asset is relocated on ship. NOT eqpInvOrgId (that is the equipment's own org). Added V343.

deliveryLocationId.description: Fusion hr_locations LocationId for deliveryInvOrgId, resolved from inventoryOrganizations at selection time. Sent to Fusion as CurrentLocationId when the maintenance asset is relocated on ship. NOT shipToLocationId, which is an FK to the local EQR_LOCATION table. Added V343.

requestorName.description: INTERNAL requestor display name, captured from the logged-in user.

requestorUsername.description: INTERNAL requestor username, captured from the logged-in user.

lines.description: One object per line: its id plus only the fields to change. At most 2000.
The request's lines in cart order; at most 2000.

data.description: One element per line sent, same order, each with its new id.

isMaintenanceTracked.description: Y/N from the line's equipment master. THE GATE for the Fusion maintenance-asset relocation on ship (resources/js/maintAssetLocation.js): only Y lines are patched. Declared here as contract, not because the projection is strict — the live API returns it, and lineStatus is read by ShipConfirmStuckLinesChain while being undeclared to this day.

isInventoryTracked.description: Y/N from the line's equipment master. Y means Fusion moves the asset itself on the transfer order's inventory transaction, in location context ORA_INVENTORY — which REST cannot write. Such lines must be left alone by the relocation.

isFixedAssetTracked.description: Y/N from the line's equipment master.

isTransactable.description: Y/N from the line's equipment master. Y means the line gets a transfer order, so an inventory transaction will move the maintenance asset in Fusion by itself - the second half of the relocation gate in resources/js/maintAssetLocation.js, and the same field openPickingDrawerChain uses to decide isFAndM.

deliveredQuantity.description: Units physically delivered to site (V243). Null until a delivery is recorded. Fields absent from this schema are dropped from the outgoing PATCH body, so this must stay declared.

consumedQuantity.description: Units consumed via a Fusion material issue (V243). Null until a consumption is recorded.

returnedQuantity.description: Units returned for a quantity-controlled item that is both issued and returned, e.g. scaffold pipe (V243).

costPostedDate.description: Set when a non-rentable (consumable/material) line's cost has been posted to PPM. NULL = not yet billed. Idempotency gate for direct-cost posting; see consumable direct-cost flow.

expenditureType.description: Authored PPM expenditure type NAME for this equipment line (V305). NULL = nobody chose; the Fusion queue defaults it to Equipment. Written by PATCH from both the Post Cost drawer and the timesheet grid. Note the service tolerates undeclared fields either way - this declaration is design-time typing, not the mechanism.

eqpInvOrgId.description: Current inventory org of the allocated unit (EQP_INV_ORG_ID). Denormalized from the serial/lot/inventory ref at allocation time so the outbound Transfer Order can derive its source org.

periodAmount.description: Authoring only â€” the total price contracted for ONE period of this tier (e.g. 1000 for a week). The cost engine never reads this; costRate is derived from it.

periodDivisor.description: Billable units (days, or hours when calcBasis=HOURLY) that periodAmount covers. Defaults to fromUnit, or 1 when fromUnit is 0. costRate = periodAmount / periodDivisor.

invOrgId.description: LOCAL surrogate key of EQR_INV_ORG — e.g. 1000032 for Chicago. This, NOT organizationId, is what EQR_SERIAL_REF.CURRENT_INV_ORG_ID points at (FK_EQR_SERIAL_INV_ORG). Writing the Fusion organizationId into that column violates the constraint.

organizationId.description: FUSION inventory OrganizationId — e.g. 300000047274450 for Chicago. Note the collection's `organizationId` QUERY PARAM is silently ignored by the server (it returns all 345 rows), so filter on `q` (code or name) or scan the list; never assume it filtered.

locationId.description: Fusion hr_locations LocationId for this organization. EQR_INV_ORG mirrors it straight from Fusion — verified identical to a live inventoryOrganizations call (Chicago 003 -> 300000047013180) — which is why resources/js/maintAssetLocation.js resolves locations from here first and only falls back to Fusion. Undeclared until now, so it was being stripped before it reached any caller.

ConfSettingRecord.description: One row of EQR_CONF_EQUIPMENT_SETTING. This table is COLUMNAR (one row per business unit, one typed column per setting) â€” settingKey/settingValue are legacy EAV fields retained only for older callers. New consumers should read the typed columns below.

settingKey.description: Legacy EAV key. Not populated by the columnar model.

settingValue.description: Legacy EAV value. Not populated by the columnar model.

isActiveFlag.description: 'Y' or 'N'. NOT NULL in the DB with default 'Y'.

marginPercentage.description: BU default markup, e.g. 10 means 10%. Seeds the quote page's per-line Markup %.

subinventoryCode.description: Fusion subinventory (SecondaryInventoryName) of this org. Optional; used as the Transfer Order DestinationSubinventoryCode when this org is the destination. Pending backend column EQR_BU_ORG_MAPPING.SUBINVENTORY_CODE.

Fusion subinventory (SecondaryInventoryName) of this org. Optional; used as the Transfer Order DestinationSubinventoryCode when this org is the destination. Pending backend column EQR_BU_ORG_MAPPING.SUBINVENTORY_CODE.

isRentable.description: Y for rentable equipment (tracks hours on a timesheet). Non-Y (consumables/materials) post cost directly and must NOT be seeded into the timesheet detail grid.

eqrEquipmentMasterId.description: The equipment MODEL on this line. Keys the per-row narrowing of the expenditure-type picker (views/exp-type-map-resolve); the row otherwise carries only equipmentName, which is a display string and cannot key a lookup.

isRentable.description: Y for rentable equipment (tracks hours on a timesheet). Non-Y (consumables/materials) post cost directly and must NOT be seeded into the timesheet detail grid.

availabilityStatus.description: AVAILABLE | PARTIAL DURATION | PARTIAL QUANTITY | NOT AVAILABLE

projectRefId.description: Fusion Project ID (er.PROJECT_REF_ID) â€” request-level; maps to PR projectDFF _PROJECT_ID

taskId.description: Fusion Task ID (er.TASK_ID) â€” request-level; maps to PR projectDFF _TASK_ID

availabilityStatus.description: AVAILABLE | PARTIAL DURATION | PARTIAL QUANTITY | NOT AVAILABLE

isFromAgreement.description: Y/N â€” line was sourced from a rental agreement

quoteVersion.description: Which send this was for the request -- history, not the mechanism for finding the current quote.

isCurrent.description: True when this is the quote named by the request's quoteId -- the one the customer should be shown.

quoteTotal.description: Sum of the quoted line totals

quoteDocument.description: Quote PDF, base64. Omitted from list responses -- fetch the document endpoint for the bytes.

QuoteDto.description: A quote sent for a request, with the lines that were offered

quoteId.description: Quote this line belongs to. Assigned by the server on create.

equipmentRequestId.description: Request the quote is for. Assigned by the server from the path.

quotedRate.description: NET rate offered -- list rate x (1 + BU margin) plus any per-line override. NOT the catalog list rate.

quotedUom.description: Unit of measure for the quoted rate

rateOverriddenFlag.description: Y when the manager overrode the computed rate

QuoteLineDto.description: One quoted line within a quote

RbacPageAccessResponse.description: Flat map keyed by RBAC_PAGES.PAGE_CODE whose value is the resolved ACCESS_LEVEL. Example: { "EQR_DASHBOARD": "FULL", "EQR_REPORTS": "READ_ONLY" }

priority.description: Lowest map priority among the caller's Fusion roles for this session role. Lower wins.

oracleRoleName.description: The Fusion job role, as stored, that carries that priority

RbacSessionRoleListResponse.description: Session roles for the caller's Fusion job roles

data.description: Every active mapped session role, ordered by priority then sessionRole. Empty when nothing maps.

moduleCode.description: Groups rows in the grid, e.g. EQUIP_MANAGER

isLocked.description: Y = not editable in the Admin grid

appRoleId.description: THE role being edited. Server must scope all writes to this.

batchNumber.description: OPTIONAL on returns. record_return neither consumes nor settles a batch; sent only for log correlation.

lineIds.description: Optional. Omit to sweep every line on the request.

reasonCode.description: TO_FAILED = retryable once the cause is fixed. TO_STALLED = still owned by the OIC poller, do NOT retry.

needsReturnResetLineIds.description: Lines still at RETURN_IN_PROCESS that must be reset before the return can be retried. A line whose return was ALREADY reset still appears in `lines` (its TO did fail) but is absent here â€” do not infer this from line status.

lineIds.description: Every line must have had ALL its inbound TOs fail; otherwise 409.

unitRefId.description: EQR_UNIT_REF id - the general unit identity. NULL on a line with no allocated unit.

unitIdentifier.description: Scannable label for any unit type, not just serials.

overdue.description: Computed SERVER-side. Do not re-derive client-side.

yardOrgId.description: From the UNIT, not the line. Line SOURCE_ORG_CODE is populated on only 20 of 164 rows.

recordCount.description: Total matching rows. Use with page/pageSize to report truncation.

fusionInventoryItemId.description: The merge key. NOT the row index.

keptMapped.description: Rows left because a human had classified them.

keptMerged.description: Rows left because they were already promoted.

validityRequired.description: Y = Valid from/to shown and required; N = hidden, stored NULL

commonDocId.description: COMMON_DOCUMENTS.DOC_ID - pass to commonService getCommonDocumentAccessUrl to view/download

validFromDate.description: yyyy-MM-dd, a calendar date - never parse with new Date()
